providerReasoningSummary: The constant segment g(x)=0 intersects at x=0 and x=1. For x<-1, -x²=a(x+1) gives a=t²/(t-1) with t>1, so extra intersections begin at a=4; for x>1, x=a adds one point when a>1. Exactly three points occur for 1<a<4, which has no maximum. Therefore the correct response is 없다, matching the repaired first choice.
